title: Self-serve signed evidence wallet and tiered security crediting
creator: Asha Kaur
description: Goal: enable customers to request and download cryptographically signed, reusable evidence bundles (an 'evidence wallet') from the Console, and to receive tiered security-credit incentives when they complete verified attestation packs. This reduces manual effort for sales/legal, accelerates procurement, and lets customers present a single signed artifact to auditors. Key elements: 1) templated answer sets (CAIQ/ISO/other frameworks) with customer-scoped overrides, 2) KMS-backed signing of bundles, 3) a persistent wallet UI and API for customers to manage signed artifacts, 4) an experiment linking completion signals to account-level security credits that can be redeemed as price adjustments or support credits.
acceptance_criteria: Console: customers can select a framework and request a signed evidence bundle for their account within 3 clicks

Signed bundle contains versioned answers, attached supporting artifacts (PDFs/policies), and a verifiable signature generated by customer-specific KMS key or Redwood signing key per customer preference
Wallet: customers can list, filter, and download past signed bundles and see signature metadata (signed_at, signer, key_id, expiry)
Telemetry: requests, completions, and downloads are emitted to observability with user/account-level tags

Security credit experiment: automation marks accounts as eligible and applies a one-time security credit in billing for completing the defined attestation pack; finance ledger entries created for audit
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): internal pilot with 5 existing enterprise customers and Sales/Legal enabled. Phase 2: gated public beta for paid accounts with consent flow for signing key selection. Phase 3: general availability with pricing-credit experiment turned on for 20% of eligible accounts initially. Each phase runs at least 2 weeks with quality gates before expansion.
metrics: Number of signed bundles per week
% of invited customers completing attestation pack
Reduction in average RFP/questionnaire turnaround time (days)
Revenue impact: credits applied vs. conversion/retention delta
tasks: PM: finalize attestation pack definitions and credit tiers with Sales and Finance
Eng: build KMS integration + signing service and wallet API (ENG-45210)
Design: Console flows for request, wallet, and download (DES-9890)
Security: threat model and key custody review, HSM/KMS options
Legal/Compliance: approval of signed artifact language and audit trail requirements
Growth/Analytics: instrumentation and billing experiment hook
Support: create runbook for common customer questions and edge cases
risks_mitigations: Risk: customers distrust Redwood-signed artifacts — Mitigation: provide option to bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via KMS and publish verification tooling
Risk: signed bundles leak sensitive config — Mitigation: default redact fields, require explicit consent for including secrets, implement artifact scanning
Risk: finance exposure from credits — Mitigation: cap credits per account, run experiment on small cohort, require legal signoff
Risk: operational complexity of long-term artifact storage — Mitigation: TTL policy, archival to customer-owned storage option
